title: Wendell and the Vow
author: Rafael Crane
blurb: Ulyana Crane, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
